used_titles: Immortal Shape-Shifters Hiding in the Deepest Ocean?! 🌊
used_scripts: Did you know the deepest ocean hides creatures that defy death? Imagine a jellyfish that can reverse its aging, becoming young again and again, living forever! Others are bizarre deep-sea worms that twist into incredible shapes, surviving crushing pressure like a dozen elephants standing on your head! Which deep-sea superpower blows your mind more?
